### `App.spec.functions[].kv[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deletion` | string, one of `retain`, `delete` | retain (the default) keeps the store and its data when the resource that declares it drops it or is deleted; delete removes them. |
| `name` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The object's name. It takes the namespace and resource group of the resource that declares it. |
| `quota` | object, [`App.spec.functions[].kv[].quota`](#appspecfunctionskvquota) | Caps on the store's total size, on each value and on each key. |
| `ref` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The name of an existing object of this kind in the namespace of the resource that declares it. A ref entry sets no other field. |
| `tables` | array of [`App.spec.functions[].kv[].tables[]`](#appspecfunctionskvtables) | The store's tables. A table is a key space with at most one writer, its owner. Table names are unique within the store, and a store with no table has nothing a Function can write. |

### `App.spec.functions[].kv[].quota`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxBytes` | integer, at least 0 | The same cap as a number of bytes. Set maxSize or maxBytes, not both. |
| `maxKeyBytes` | integer, 0 to 64000 | The longest key, in bytes. 0 means 1024 (1 KiB). |
| `maxSize` | string, a size: 1 to 15 digits and an optional binary unit, Ki, Mi, Gi or Ti, with or without a B (512Ki, 2GiB) | The cap on the total size held, above zero. Set maxSize or maxBytes, not both; neither means no cap. A write that would pass the cap gets 507. |
| `maxValueBytes` | integer, 0 to 1048576 | The largest value a write may store, in bytes. 0 means 1048576 (1 MiB). |

### `App.spec.functions[].kv[].tables[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The table's name, unique within the store. |
| `owner` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The one Function that may write the table, in the store's namespace. In a store that a Function declares, it defaults to that Function. In a KVStore applied on its own, an empty owner means that no Function can write the table. Every Function, the owner included, reaches the table through an entry of its spec.bindings.kv. |

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `hooks` | array of [`AppRevision.status.hooks[]`](#apprevisionstatushooks) |  |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |
| `startedAt` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) |  |

### `AppRevision.status.hooks[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `endTime` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) |  |
| `function` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label |  |
| `invocation` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label |  |
| `phase` | string, required, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` |  |
| `point` | string, required, one of `preApply`, `postApply` |  |
